description: Describes a component that can be placed on the wireframe canvas. Each Tempo.Blazor component (TmButton, TmDataTable, …) has exactly one definition. Custom components register their own via .

members.name: DefaultHeight
members.description: Default height in pixels applied when dropping from the Toolbox.

members.name: DefaultWidth
members.description: Default width in pixels applied when dropping from the Toolbox.

members.name: DisplayName
members.description: Human-readable name shown in the Toolbox and Properties Panel header.

members.name: Icon
members.description: TmIcon name used in the Toolbox list item.

members.name: IsBuiltIn
members.description: True for built-in Tempo.Blazor components; false for custom/JSON-defined ones.

members.name: Props
members.description: Property definitions that drive the Properties Panel UI.

members.name: RenderSvg
members.description: Renders the wireframe SVG shape into . Coordinates inside the render are relative to the element's top-left (0, 0). The outer <g> transform is applied by the canvas.

members.name: SizePresets
members.description: Optional map from a size prop value to canonical element dimensions. When the user changes the size prop and the new value has an entry here, the canvas element is automatically resized to these dimensions. Components where size describes an internal sub-element (e.g. TmModal's dialog inside a full-screen overlay) should leave this null and handle sizing in their render lambda.

members.name: Type
members.description: Unique type identifier – must match . Examples: "TmButton", "TmDataTable", "MyProductCard".
